mapper.select: SELECT tst.id team_id, tsr.* FROM third_sport_team_ranking tsr JOIN third_sport_team tst ON tsr.third_team_source_id = tst.third_team_source_id JOIN third_match_team_relation tmtr ON tst.id = tmtr.team_id WHERE tsr.third_source_season_id = #{seasonId} AND tmtr.match_id = #{matchId} order by tsr.third_source_season_id
